remarks: Beautiful 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom apartment located in the Cove with 1 assigned off street parking spot, guest parking and extra street parking . This newly renovated apartment features a stunning kitchen with quartz countertops, custom cabinets, large living room with hardwood floors, as well as a beautiful bathroom with tiled walls. The bedrooms are spacious and come with custom closets, providing plenty of storage space. High efficiency heating and lighting! Assigned private parking and laundry in the building make life even easier for you. You'll love the peaceful and secluded location of this apartment. Water, landscaping, trash and snow removal are all included. Conveniently located close to downtown, beaches, parks, train station and Chelsea piers. Pets and smoking are not allowed. This unit is a Must see!!
